description_en: Queries the time series statistics of all traffic, including malicious requests and normal service requests
description_zh: 查询所有流量的时序统计数据，包含恶意请求和正常的业务请求
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-network-flow-time-series-metric --instance-id 'waf_cdnsdf3****' --filter '{"DateRange":{"StartDate":1713888000,"EndDate":1713888600}}' --metric total_requests --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNetworkFlowTimeSeriesMetric

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:

matched_host: the protected object.
cluster: the protection cluster
fields.help_zh:
执行过滤操作的字段名称，当前接口的Key只支持如下两个字段：

matched_host：防护对象。
cluster：防护集群
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The list of filter conditions. Each node describes a filter condition
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件列表，每一个节点描述一个过滤条件
fields.name: conditions

fields.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
fields.help_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
fields.name: end_date

The start time of the query. The time range for the query cannot exceed the past 30 days. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
The start time must be later than 30 days before the current time.

开始时间必须晚于当前时间减去30天。

fields.help_en: The time range for the query
fields.name: date_range

parameters.help_en: The query filter conditions. Multiple filter conditions are combined by using the logical AND operator
parameters.help_zh: 查询过滤条件，多个过滤条件之间是逻辑与的关系
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The metric used to distinguish the returned data content. Different metrics correspond to different data content. This operation supports the following metrics:

qps: returns the number of requests processed by WAF per second. The peak calculation method is used. A QPS value is calculated every 10 seconds, and the maximum peak value among multiple values is used as the QPS value within the current statistical time granularity.
total_requests: returns the total number of requests processed by WAF.
top5_status: returns the top 5 response codes returned by WAF to the client and the corresponding time series statistics.
top 5_upstream_status: returns the top 5 response codes returned by the origin server to the client and the corresponding time series statistics
parameters.help_zh:
用于区分返回的数据内容，不同的Metric对应不同的数据内容，该接口支持的Metric如下：

qps: 返回waf每秒处理的请求数，采用峰值计算方法，每10秒计算出一个qps值，最后从多个值中取最大峰值作为当前统计时间粒度内的qps值。
total_requests: 返回waf处理的总请求数。
top5_status: 返回waf返回给客户端的top5响应码，以及对应的时间序列统计数据。
top 5_upstream_status: 返回源站返回给客户端的top5响应码，以及对应的时间序列统计数据
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

schema.description_en: The returned data results. For format examples, see Examples
schema.description_zh: 返回的数据结果，格式样例参见示例

NetworkFlowTimeSeries.description_en: The returned time series data. Time series data of multiple values can be returned
NetworkFlowTimeSeries.description_zh: 返回的时间序列数据，支持返回多个值的时间序列数据

items.description_en: A single piece of time series data. The time series data mainly includes two arrays, which correspond to the Timestamps and Values arrays. The Timestamps array contains the time series at fixed time intervals, and the Values array contains the statistical counts within each fixed time interval. The two arrays contain the same number of nodes, and their data points have a one-to-one correspondence
items.description_zh: 单个时间序列数据，时间序列数据主要包含两个数组，分别对应Timestamps和Values数组，Timestamps数组中包含了固定时间间隔的时间序列，Values数组中包含了每个固定时间间隔内的统计计数，这两个数组包含的节点个数是一样的，两者的数据点是一一对应的关系

Metric.description_en: The returned data content. The meaning is consistent with the Metric parameter in the request parameters
Metric.description_zh: 返回的数据内容，跟入参中的Metric含义保持一致

Timestamps.description_en: The time series. Each point represents the start time of a time range
Timestamps.description_zh: 时间序列，每个点代表一个时间范围的起始时间

items.description_en: The start statistical time of each data statistical point. The value is a UNIX timestamp string
items.description_zh: 每个数据统计点的起始统计时间，使用UNIX时间戳字符串表示

Values.description_en: The data series. Each point represents the statistical count within a specific time range
Values.description_zh: 数据序列，每个点代表一定时间范围内的统计计数

items.description_en: The statistical count within the current time range
items.description_zh: 当前时间范围的统计计数

TimeSeriesMetaData.description_en: The metadata of the returned data

AggregateInterval.description_en: The statistical time granularity of each data point in the returned time series data. For example, "15m" indicates that each returned data point is the statistical data for every 15 minutes. For more information about the time granularity of the returned data, see Description of the time granularity of time series data points
AggregateInterval.description_zh: 返回的时间序列数据中，每个数据点的统计时间粒度，比如"15m"则表示返回的每个数据点是每15分钟的统计数据。返回数据的时间粒度参见时间序列数据点时间粒度说明

DateRange.description_en: The time range used for the query
DateRange.description_zh: 查询时使用的时间范围

EndDate.description_en: The end time used for querying data. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This value is the same as the EndDate parameter in the request parameters
EndDate.description_zh: 查询数据时使用的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。该值和入参数重的EndDate一致

StartDate.description_en: The start time used for querying data. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. This value is the same as the StartDate parameter in the request parameters
StartDate.description_zh: 查询数据时使用的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。该值和入参数重的StartDate一致

Units.description_en: The unit of the returned statistical data. Default value: requests
Units.description_zh: 返回的统计数据的单位。默认值为requests
